complete_examples.text: With wheel–rail nonlinear creepage/equivalent stiffness, this proposed model can derive dynamic results approaching to those of vehicle-track coupled dynamics.

The model presented in this paper has nonlinear creepage and equivalent stiffness characteristics; however, it can be degraded into a linear model conveniently by linearizing the nonlinear properties.
